==General tips==

Hi there BigBrrother703,

I'm ASisterOfTheBlue, third in rank of this wikia. Along with Mainphramephreak and recently Rmmateus and Acarna, I am the single most active member of the board.

We're always appreciative of help and assistance, but recently I've noticed several not only spelling and grammatical errors but pure factual fauls in your edits. Once again, we always like to see a new face, but would you please double-check your info before editing? It leaves us unnecessary work otherwise.

I made mistakes at the beginning too, don't feel too insulted. I'm just trying to help you avoid making the same. For one, don't believe the board is wrong in its structure. Read enough articles to see the structure before trying to correct it. 

Thank you.

[[User:ASisterOfTheBlue|ASisterOfTheBlue]] ([[User talk:ASisterOfTheBlue|talk]]) 18:44, December 4, 2013 (UTC)

P.S. Always here for questions. D.S.

==Concerning Elayne Trakand==

Hi there bigBrrother703,

Once and for all, let me explain this. Yes, the artist who drew the cover for the Path of Daggers - the picture of Elayne, Aviendha and Nynaeve around the Bowl of Winds - did screw the hair colours up. He switched hair colours on Elayne and Aviendha.

I've noticed that you often undo my correction or edit it otherwise, causing me unnecessary work, in that picture on Elayne's page. Look at the dresses. Who is more likely to wear a green and golden gown, and who is likelier to wear the clothes of a Wise One and a dagger in her belt? Yes, the order is Elayne, Aviendha, Nynaeve.

I would appreciate it greatly if you would stop giving me faulty edits to  correct, please. Thank you.

[[User:ASisterOfTheBlue|ASisterOfTheBlue]] ([[User talk:ASisterOfTheBlue|talk]]) 10:44, December 9, 2013 (UTC)

== This is getting silly ==

Okay, so judging by ASisterOfTheBlue's comments I am not the only one becoming frustrated by this. Please stop editing the Elayne Trakand page to say that Elayne is the one in the middle. If you still disagree despite ASisterOfTheBlue's comments on your page, mine on the Elayne talk page and Rmmateus' on the edit history page, hopefully this will put it to bed: [http://www.tor.com/blogs/2010/05/lemgthe-path-of-daggerslemg-ebook-cover-by-julie-bell#105645 The Path of Daggers ebook cover by Julie Bell]. That is a comment on Tor ''from the artist who drew the picture ''specifically stating the order is Elayne on the left, Aviendha in the middle, Nynaeve on the right. 

In the future, if you edit something on a page and it gets undone, rather than simply re-editing it back over and over again which is very annoying for all parties involved it might be a better idea to consult with the person who undid your edit and discuss why you disagree with what is on the page, particularly if that person is not one but three of the most active users on the website. [[User:Acarna|Acarna]] ([[User talk:Acarna|talk]]) 17:26, February 24, 2014 (UTC)
